content: क्रोधः [क्रुध्-भावे घञ्] .²1 Anger, wrath; कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते <ls>Bg. 2. 62</ls>; so क्रोधान्धः, क्रोधानलः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) Anger considered as the feeling which gives rise to the {%raudra%} sentiment. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the mystic syllable हुम् or ह्रुम्. .²4 (also क्रोधन) <ab>N.</ab> of the 59th year of the संवत्सर cycle. .{@-धा@} <ab>N.</ab> of a daughter of Dakṣa.
